name: Afcom Holdings Limited
summary: Afcom Holdings Limited provides air freight transportation services in ASEAN Countries. The company provides cargo solutions and products, including general cargo, flying fresh, flying pharma, flying priority, fly courier, project cargo, dangerous goods, and high-value cargo. It also owns, organizes, manages, runs, charters, conducts, contracts, develops, handles, and operates aircrafts, air buses, aeroplanes, seaplanes, flying boats, hover crafts, helicopters, and other crafts used in air transport for the carriage of passengers, goods, mails, and other items.
